description: Election Commission - The symbols, approved for the purposes of elections prescribed in the Parliamentary Elections Act No. 1 of 1981
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, as it contains the Election Commission's cancellation and approval of political party symbols for parliamentary elections under the Parliamentary Elections Act No. 1 of 1981. The content focuses entirely on election-related administrative matters (symbol allocation) rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
